body.statement: For a finite counterfactual query with \(q\) terms and a causal graph with \(n\) vertices, CTF-REALIZE decides whether the query is realizable from the given explicit action set in \(O(qn^2)\) time and the same order of space.

source.locator: Theorem 3.5, page 6, and Appendix C.3, page 20
source.verbatim_statement: The time complexity of Algorithm 1 is O(kn²), where k is the number of terms in the input query Q

attestation.note: Primary author PDF https://causalai.net/r113.pdf, Appendix C.3, retrieved and text-extracted 2026-09-11; the immediately following sentence states equal space complexity.
